parameters.name: BeginTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the group to query.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the instance to which the group belongs.

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description: The sampling period. Unit: minutes. Valid values: 1, 5, and 10.

parameters.name: Topic
parameters.description: The name of the topic to query.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of information to query. Valid values:

- **0**: The statistical curve of the total number of consumed messages.

- **1**: The statistical curve of the TPS for message consumption.
